specification.objective: Align the shared TouchIn workspace brand header with the supplied visual reference on every authenticated workspace route, preserving page content, theme modes, navigation, and authentication behavior.

requirements.statement: Expanded, compact, mobile, and collapsed workspace brand containers use the current theme surface; the amber accent is confined to the square fingerprint mark.
The fingerprint mark uses the theme's onPrimary color on the amber accent tile; wordmark and descriptor use onSurface and onSurfaceVariant respectively; menu and collapse controls use onSurface.

All six authenticated workspace destinations continue to use the shared responsive navigation without changing route behavior, dimensions, page content, or interactions; the separate AuthShell remains unchanged.
Canonical desktop/mobile light/dark navigation snapshots and their provenance hashes match the resulting shared brand in the Ubuntu 24.04 / Flutter 3.47.2 CI environment.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Widget tests in light and dark themes verify surface-backed brand containers, an amber fingerprint tile with contrasting icon, and theme-derived wordmark/descriptor colors; wordmark and descriptor contrast is at least 4.5:1 and the fingerprint graphic contrast is at least 3:1.
Mobile menu and collapsed expand controls remain accessible, functional, and theme-contrasting, and existing narrow-width navigation tests pass without layout exceptions.

All six authenticated routes render the shared header consistently at desktop and 390x844 mobile viewport, with no horizontal overflow and existing page actions intact; AuthShell behavior is unchanged.

All four canonical navigation snapshots are regenerated/verified in the repository's Ubuntu CI job using Flutter 3.47.2, and docs/validation/issue-119/README.md records their actual provenance and SHA-256 hashes.

invariants.statement: No route, destination, API call, permission check, session, logout behavior, page data, page action, or AuthShell layout changes.
Light/dark theme settings, keyboard/touch target sizes, focus treatment, responsive breakpoints, sidebar width, and compact-navigation behavior remain intact.
The amber accent remains meaningful and restrained; no gradients, glows, new dependencies, invented content, or decorative effects are introduced.

forbidden_states.statement: The brand header paints a full-width amber band instead of the theme surface with a compact amber fingerprint tile.
Wordmark, descriptor, menu, collapse control, or fingerprint icon has insufficient contrast in either theme.
A workspace destination, authentication route, navigation action, responsive behavior, or page content changes or overflows.

inputs.statement: The existing AppTheme light/dark color schemes, shared WorkspaceNavigationBrand, and six authenticated workspace destinations.
The user-supplied TouchIn UI reference image and canonical navigation test fixtures.

outputs.statement: A theme-consistent shared workspace brand header with a restrained amber logo tile across desktop, mobile, and collapsed navigation.
Widget, contrast, canonical screenshot, and route-level visual evidence for the shared change.

failure_semantics.statement: A theme or state that does not meet required text/graphic contrast fails a labeled widget or contrast assertion before the change is accepted.
Canonical screenshots that differ from the resulting shared brand fail the Ubuntu Flutter 3.47.2 golden job; do not regenerate them on macOS or Windows.
